desc:
🐒 Welcome to +1 Jump Monkey Escape!

Train, jump higher, and climb your way to the top! 🚀
CODE: WELCOME

How to Play:
⚡ Every step gives you EXP!
🏃 Train on treadmills to grow stronger!
⬆️ Jump higher and explore animal zones!
🏆 Collect Wins to unlock powerful upgrades!
🌎 Unlock more worlds and reach new heights!

🎁 Join our community to claim FREE rewards!
👍 Like the game and favorite ⭐ to support future updates!
🎉 At 1,000 Likes, we’ll release a special reward code for everyone!
